facts.text: The resort is in the private Cabo del Sol community and is shaped by the desert and the sea.
facts.excerpt: Nestled in the private Cabo del Sol community, Park Hyatt Cabo del Sol is a coastal sanctuary shaped by the desert, sea and the Baja

facts.text: The resort's beach club includes a dedicated adults-only pool and private cabanas.
facts.excerpt: The only luxury resort beach club in Los Cabos includes a dedicated adults-only pool and private cabanas.

facts.text: Ocean-facing family pools and full-service lounging areas are located throughout the resort.
facts.excerpt: Ocean-facing family pools and refined lounging areas with full service are located throughout the resort.

facts.text: Select suites and villas have private plunge pools.
facts.excerpt: Select suites and villas feature private plunge pools for an elevated sense of privacy.

facts.text: The wellness center offers personalized wellness treatments, a fitness center, a yoga studio, a lap pool and a nail salon.
facts.excerpt: a serene sanctuary featuring personalized wellness treatments, a 24-hour fitness center, yoga studio, lap pool, nail salon and more

facts.text: The resort's spa is called Saria Spa.
facts.excerpt: wellness rituals and thoughtful treatments at Saria Spa

facts.text: Mesa Madre serves authentic Mexican cuisine inspired by the traditions of the abuela, the grandmother at the heart of every kitchen.
facts.excerpt: At Mesa Madre, dining is a celebration of authentic Mexican cuisine inspired by the traditions of the abuela at the heart of every kitchen.

facts.text: Costamar is a beachfront beach club with a toes-in-the-sand Baja experience.
facts.excerpt: Costamar is a beachfront beach club in Los Cabos offering a quintessential toes-in-the-sand Baja experience

facts.text: Costamar overlooks the Sea of Cortez and serves Coastal Californian cuisine inspired by the peninsula.
facts.excerpt: Overlooking the Sea of Cortez, the restaurant features Coastal Californian cuisine inspired by the peninsula

facts.text: Silan serves Middle Eastern cuisine in the evening, drawing inspiration from North Africa to the Levant.
facts.excerpt: Silán is an evening destination for Middle Eastern cuisine in Los Cabos, drawing inspiration from North Africa to the Levant.

facts.text: The Silan menu is currently being offered nightly at Mesa Madre.
facts.excerpt: Please note: Silán Menu currently being offered nightly at Mesa Madre.

facts.text: Datil is a specialty coffee shop with freshly baked pastries, artisanal chocolates and whole-leaf teas.
facts.excerpt: Guests can enjoy freshly baked pastries, artisanal chocolates, and delicate confections alongside thoughtfully brewed coffee and whole-leaf teas.

facts.text: The Pool Bar serves small plates and traditional antojitos with a cocktail program and wine by the glass.
facts.excerpt: Guests can enjoy small plates and traditional antojitos alongside an extensive cocktail program and a curated wine-by-the-glass selection

facts.text: Guests get preferred tee times at the Desert Course and are close to Anima Village, a boutique luxury shopping and cultural hub.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy preferred tee-times at the Desert Course and proximity to Anima Village, a boutique luxury shopping and cultural hub.

facts.text: The hotel was named on the Conde Nast Traveler 2026 Hot List of new hotels.
facts.excerpt: Park Hyatt Cabo del Sol has been recognized on the Condé Nast Traveler 2026 Hot List among the world

facts.text: Each room has a private terrace or patio, and many have plunge pools and ocean views.

facts.text: Rooms have a bathroom with a deep-soaking tub and a walk-in shower.
facts.excerpt: a stylish bathroom with deep-soaking tub and walk-in shower

facts.text: The two-bedroom villa has a kitchen and a generous living room.
facts.excerpt: as well as a kitchen and a generous living room

facts.text: The hotel offers a private land and sea journey with a panga ride to the Arch and Lovers Beach, mission visits, a blown glass factory and tequila tasting.
facts.excerpt: discover Cabo on a curated land and sea journey with a private panga ride to the Arch and Lovers Beach, plus mission visits, local shops, a blown glass factory and tequila tasting

facts.text: The Agave Journey is a guided tasting of agave spirits with curated pairings.
facts.excerpt: Discover agave spirits through a guided tasting with curated pairings.

facts.excerpt: Enjoy the coastal beauty of Chileno Bay with Park Hyatt Cabo del Sol, featuring crystal-clear waters, snorkeling, paddleboarding and a relaxed beachside atmosphere.

facts.text: Dogs are welcome, and in the room a pet gets its own bed, water bowl and treats.
facts.excerpt: In your room, your pet will be welcomed with its own plush bed, water bowl, and treats.
